sentences: On the guidance, we expect high single-digit consolidated top line growth for FY27 based on our current understanding of the regulatory and macro environment.
We expect our FY27 R&D spend to be 6% to 7% of the sales for the next year.
I can't specifically give you a response as to whether it will be 40%, 60%, 45%, what you call 55% or maybe different.
We expect the effective tax rate to be in the range of 25%.
During the quarter, an exceptional charge of Rs.4,895 million was taken primarily on account of wage code gratuity as per ICI guidelines and additional provision for GxMDL final settlement.
